original_coverage_E: Western Australia, South Australia, Northern Territory, Victoria and Tasmania, plus the WA-administered Indian Ocean territories (Christmas Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands).
coverage_T: Australia (Western Australia [entire ADM1], South Australia [entire ADM1], Northern Territory [entire ADM1], Victoria [entire ADM1], Tasmania [entire ADM1]); Christmas Island [entire ADM0]; Cocos (Keeling) Islands [entire ADM0]
changes_vs_old: Added Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands (previously unassigned in old T).
notes: Contiguity: mainland states are land-connected (WA-NT-SA-Vic); Tasmania via Bass Strait ferry/short flights (Spirit of Tasmania); Christmas and Cocos Is. are Australian external territories administered under WA law, ~2,600 km from Perth (flights only) - accepted long ocean link, ~2,500 people. Populations: ABS ERP-based state shares scaled to Australia total ~27.5m. Australia ADM1 = state/territory (no ADM2 needed).

original_coverage_E: New South Wales, Queensland, ACT and Jervis Bay Territory, Norfolk Island, plus New Zealand (incl. Chatham Islands) and the NZ-realm territories Cook Islands, Niue and Tokelau.
coverage_T: Australia (New South Wales [entire ADM1], Queensland [entire ADM1], Australian Capital Territory [entire ADM1], Jervis Bay Territory [entire ADM1]); Norfolk Island [entire ADM0]; New Zealand [entire ADM0]; Cook Islands [entire ADM0]; Niue [entire ADM0]; Tokelau [entire ADM0]
changes_vs_old: Added Jervis Bay Territory; moved Norfolk Island from seat 500, and Cook Islands, Niue and Tokelau (NZ realm) from seat 500, to reduce Pacific-seat sprawl.
notes: Sea link: Australia-New Zealand across the Tasman Sea (~2,200 km, Sydney/Brisbane-Auckland direct flights, strong trans-Tasman ties, CER, free movement) - accepted long sea link. Norfolk Island (Sydney/Brisbane/Auckland flights) and NZ-realm territories (NZ citizens, Auckland-served) are also overseas links. Chatham Islands are part of New Zealand ADM0 (ADM1 region). NSW and Victoria split not needed: whole states used, so Sydney/Melbourne are not divided. Note pop ~20.0m is near the 20.8m upper band edge (within band). NZ ADM1 = regions (not enumerated since entire ADM0).

original_coverage_E: Papua New Guinea and all other Pacific islands outside the NZ realm: Melanesia (Solomon Is., Vanuatu, Fiji, New Caledonia), Polynesia (Samoa, American Samoa, Tonga, French Polynesia, Wallis & Futuna, Pitcairn, Tuvalu), Micronesia (Kiribati, Nauru, Marshall Is., FSM, Palau, Guam, N. Mariana Is.) and Hawaii.
coverage_T: Papua New Guinea [entire ADM0]; Solomon Islands [entire ADM0]; Vanuatu [entire ADM0]; New Caledonia [entire ADM0]; Fiji [entire ADM0]; Wallis and Futuna [entire ADM0]; Samoa [entire ADM0]; American Samoa [entire ADM0]; Tonga [entire ADM0]; Tuvalu [entire ADM0]; French Polynesia [entire ADM0]; Pitcairn Islands [entire ADM0]; Kiribati [entire ADM0]; Nauru [entire ADM0]; Marshall Islands [entire ADM0]; Micronesia (Federated States of) [entire ADM0]; Palau [entire ADM0]; Guam [entire ADM0]; Northern Mariana Islands [entire ADM0]; United States (Hawaii [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Removed Norfolk Island, Cook Islands, Niue, Tokelau (now seat 499); listed overseas territories as their own ADM0 (geoBoundaries style); Hawaii as ADM1 of United States.
notes: Documented exception: Pacific island seat with long ocean links (PNG-Solomons-Vanuatu-Fiji-Polynesia-Micronesia-Hawaii span thousands of km; connected by air and shipping, no single ferry route). Linked by Oceania regional institutions (Pacific Islands Forum, SPC) and trade/air hubs (Fiji, Guam, Honolulu). Hawaii (Polynesian, US state) is the northeastern outlier. PNG population is the largest uncertainty (no recent reliable census; ~10.8m assumed, WPP-style). Territory pops are small round official/UN figures; small ADM0s are not split.
